comment: RDNA3 cases for bench.py (RX 7700 XT, gfx1101; AMD 26.10.1, HAGS off). Same method and thresholds as matrix.json. size = render W, H, output W, H. dx-K runs DXIL unless the case sets D4R_D3DHIP_K=1 (d3dhip); dx-M/L run the RDNA 3 package (FP16 WMMA); dx-RRD/RRE run the gfx11 packages (engine\rr-d-gfx11, rr-e-gfx11). dx-K-q1440 is Ghost of Tsushima's Quality case (docs/windows-k-d3dhip.md). The -default K cases set no D4R_D3DHIP_K: they measure the shipped choice of route. dx-L-up-* run preset L at Ultra Performance (a third of the output per axis), its intended mode; dx-M-* are Performance (half).
benign: a frame the engine cannot record is logged|CUDA_Init\(app|IDENTITY_FALLBACK|NGXLoadFromPath|registry query|needs an RDNA 4 GPU|no RDNA 3 package
